title: Plausible, robust biological oscillations through allelic buffering.
authors: Hsieh, Feng-Shu; Nguyen, Duy P M; Heltberg, Mathias S; Wu, Chia-Chou; Lee, Yi-Chen; Jensen, Mogens H; Chen, Sheng-Hong
one_liner_zh: 该文研究p53-Mdm2振荡的等位基因缓冲机制，属细胞信号动态调控，无蛋白质-DNA互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Biological oscillators can specify time- and dose-dependent functions via dedicated control of their oscillatory dynamics. However, how biological oscillators, which recurrently activate noisy biochemical processes, achieve robust oscillations remains unclear. Here, we characterize the long-term oscillations of p53 and its negative feedback regulator Mdm2 in single cells after DNA damage. Whereas p53 oscillates regularly, Mdm2 from a single MDM2 allele exhibits random unresponsiveness to  approximately 9% of p53 pulses. Using allelic-specific imaging of MDM2 activity, we show that MDM2 alleles buffer each other to maintain p53 pulse amplitude. Removal of MDM2 allelic buffering cripples the robustness of p53 amplitude, thereby elevating p21 levels and cell-cycle arrest. In silico simulations support that allelic buffering enhances the robustness of biological oscillators and broadens their plausible biochemical space. Our findings show how allelic buffering ensures robust p53 oscillations, highlighting the potential importance of allelic buffering for the emergence of robust biological oscillators during evolution. A record of this paper's transparent peer review process is included in the supplemental information.
abstract_zh: 生物振荡器能够通过对其振荡动力学的专门控制来指定时间和剂量依赖的功能。然而，生物振荡器如何反复激活噪声生化过程并实现稳健振荡，仍不清楚。在此，我们表征了DNA损伤后单细胞中p53及其负反馈调节因子Mdm2的长期振荡。尽管p53规律性地振荡，来自单个MDM2等位基因的Mdm2却对约9%的p53脉冲表现出随机无响应。利用MDM2活性的等位基因特异性成像，我们显示MDM2等位基因相互缓冲以维持p53脉冲幅度。去除MDM2等位基因缓冲会削弱p53幅度的稳健性，从而提高p21水平并导致细胞周期停滞。计算机模拟支持等位基因缓冲增强了生物振荡器的稳健性并拓宽了其可能的生化空间。我们的发现展示了等位基因缓冲如何确保p53振荡的稳健性，强调了等位基因缓冲在进化过程中对稳健生物振荡器出现可能具有的重要性。本论文的透明同行评审过程记录包含在补充信息中。
